description: Persisted PCT_Dev30_v0 cohort roster, replacing the conversational-only record established across prior turns. Firm and filing identity for every row is claimed from THESIS_REPO's own final_filing_manifest.csv (the legacy corpus, walled off from UNIVERSE_v1 per the standing authority-boundary instruction), never from this project's Stage 00C acquisition pipeline -- no row carries a sec-primary: source identity. The roster, stratification block assignment, dev/holdout partition, and difficulty rating are recovered unchanged from the prior agreed conversation record; none is invented here. This manifest is fixture/data-contract only: it authorizes no PCT extraction prompt run, no Dev30 scoring, no gold-label creation, and no holdout-output access.

legacy_corpus_reference.verification_note: repo_remote is descriptive metadata only, not a verification basis; no fetch was performed to confirm the local legacy checkout matches this remote.
